chunk_findings.detail: The new fake `pre-commit` stub reports `tests....Passed` whenever `SKIP` does not contain the exact token `tests`, regardless of whether the test hook actually had test files to run. In the “hook skipped for want of a test file is unavailable” scenario named in the comment, `SKIP` is unset (or does not name `tests`), so the stub still prints `tests....Passed`; CI will then see the tests hook as available/passed even though the hook should be unavailable. Any test in this file relying on missing-test-file/unavailable behavior passes vacuously because the stub forces a passed test hook.
